libraryIdentity.purpose: Stable identity plus explicit operator attestation prevents a missing, changed, or unrelated NAS from being attached silently to restored catalog state.

permanent.description: Must survive loss of the laptop and is never automatically reclaimed.
items: canonical media rows and content hashes
manual metadata, corrections, notes, and favorites
database backup manifests and recovery attempts
permanent.recoverySource: original NAS library plus verified encrypted PostgreSQL backup

recoverable.description: Stored in the verified database backup and restored when present; it may be regenerated without changing permanent user decisions.
items: face scan state and derived face rows
job checkpoints, cursors, and resumable operation state

rebuildable.description: Optional cache bytes are not required for catalog recovery and may be absent after a laptop loss.
items: local AI and face model caches
rebuildable.recoverySource: rebuild from the unchanged NAS originals after the library is reattached
rebuildable.automaticReclaim: Only bounded, job-owned or explicitly rebuildable derivatives; never originals, recycle contents, protected backups, or permanent metadata.

requiredAfterRestore: canonical media counts, relative identities, and SHA-256 hashes
manual metadata, corrections, albums, tags, and favorites
faults: stale, foreign, or incompatible recovery material
